newsletter.footer.lede: A few times a year, Marijn writes a proper letter: about a winemaker we just visited, a region that caught our attention again, a bottle that made an impression.

langhe.capture.a.body: This article covers the essentials. Want more: where we tasted, which wineries stayed with us and what a trip like this costs? That is in The Letter, which Marijn writes every two weeks.
langhe.capture.c.body: Want to know where to begin in the Langhe? In The Letter I write about routes, wineries and what it costs, from personal experience.
